summary: Master digital agriculture and farmer data systems with practical tools, GIS, dashboards, and governance templates. Enroll to build field-ready skills.
lede: Digital agriculture brings farm records, GIS maps, sensor data and analytics together to support field and operational decisions. For professionals working with agronomy records, irrigation logs and digital farm platforms, the course focuses on turning scattered field observations into decision-ready information through farmer data schema design, field mapping and interpretation of sensor and weather records. Exercises also cover reporting and governance controls for data quality, sharing and permissions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work with field data, agronomy records, GIS outputs, irrigation logs, and digital farm platforms.
audience: Irrigation supervisors using sensor readings for water
prerequisites: Bring a laptop, spreadsheet software, and access to sample farm records if available. If your organization already uses ODK, QGIS, mobile field apps, or sensor dashboards, those materials can be used during exercises subject to validation in class.
